metadata.description: browser-shield, an ad blocker and safety guard for the browsers Claude drives

plugins.name: browser-shield
plugins.description: Ad blocker and safety guard for Claude's own browsers: refuses ad, malware and phishing sites in the desktop app's Browser pane, Claude in Chrome and WebFetch, skips YouTube ads and rejects cookie banners with an in-page script, and asks before downloads, payment pages and paste-into-Terminal lures. macOS. Unofficial.
